title: TS-Skill: A Benchmark for Evaluating Analytical Skills in Time-Series Question Answering

claim.summary: TS-Skill controls temporal scale selection, localization and cross-interval integration in timestamped QA; SKEvol generates and verifies questions against synthetic signals.

modules.name: Skill-controlled temporal QA evaluation
modules.scope_reason: Evaluation probes temporal question answering and skill compositions, not task execution across all four application families.

modules.name: Signal-grounded QA generation and verification
modules.scope_reason: The generator verifies timestamps, computed values, units and metadata/plot agreement for QA pairs.
